issues: Document has no ТР ТС / раздел section headings anywhere - tr_section is null on every row per rules. okpd2_code column (col 4) is blank on every page of the source document, so it is null throughout. Several numbered table items list one method/indicator with two or three range values under different measurement conditions (без учета разбавления/при разбавлении/при концентрировании); these were split into separate JSON rows with the condition appended to the indicator text, each carrying its own range. Row 52 (ПНД Ф 14.1:2:4.186, Бенз(а)пирен) prints two equivalent ranges in different units (0,5-500 нг/дм3 and the mg/dm3 equivalent in parentheses); the нг/дм3 range was used for range_from/range_to/unit and the full text preserved in raw_row_text. Item 57/58 in the source both print the same norm_doc label 'ПНД Ф 14.1:2:4.140' as printed. Item 65 (МУ 4149 Приложение 8.8, Гексен/Гептен) prints two different-unit ranges (мг/кг threshold and мг/м3 range) which were split into two rows each. All pages rendered upright at 150dpi with no rotation needed; scan quality was generally clear.
